data.rationale: The proposal follows the same procedure (Book > Hotels, type destination and pick a suggestion, select dates, Search) and names destination, check-in and check-out as parameters. It folds sorting and filtering into one vague last step, doesn't name sort as a parameter, and ends with "open See availability" where the true workflow sorts by price, but a automation could still be built from it.
